name: hmharness
description: hmharness - a next-generation, self-evolving agent framework designed around the full HarmonyOS development lifecycle. Clean-room design; borrows the best 2026 ideas (loop engineering, MCP, skill-library evolution) without inheriting any runtime dependency.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hmh/kernel && npm run build -w @hmh/evolution && npm run build -w @hmh/domain-harmony && npm run build -w @hmh/agent && npm run build -w @hmh/web && npm run build -w @hmh/cli
